tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Search the AI tools directory by free-text query, industry department, and/or pricing tier. Returns matching tools with name, URL, department, pricing tier and description.

tools.name: get_ai_tool
tools.description: Get the full record for one AI tool by name (exact match first, then fuzzy).

tools.name: list_departments
tools.description: List all industry departments in the directory with the number of tools in each.

tools.name: find_free_ai_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools with a free tier, optionally filtered by auto-extracted facts (no credit card required, has a free plan, API available on the free tier). Free-tier facts are auto-extracted and unverified.

tools.name: directory_stats
tools.description: Get summary statistics for the directory: tool count, department count, pricing distribution, and how many tools have auto-extracted free-tier facts.
